integrity.mathematical_basis: Complete exact Bellman/odds derivation and explicit unbounded-delay family.
integrity.reproducibility: Standard-library exact rational independent direct recurrence and closed-form comparison, with preserved output.

scientific_limitations: Exact-model success-conditioning updates in an acyclic two-nonterminal-state discounted MDP only.
The suppression asymptotic varies the initial downstream optimal-action mass; fixed positive support is not a uniform impossibility statement.
No sampled-trajectory, policy-gradient or function-approximation guarantee.
Potential older equivalent formulations in EM or multiplicative-weights literature remain a priority risk.
title: Arbitrarily deep optimal-action suppression in a two-stage success-conditioning chain
